gaps.sentence: She was ___ (GRATE) for all their support.
She gave a very ___ (CONFUSE) explanation of the rules.
gaps.explanation: 'Confusing' describes something that causes confusion; 'confused' describes the person affected.
'Optimistic' is the adjective; 'optimism' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: The thief was ___ (ARREST) at the border.
He was praised for his ___ (BRAVE) during the fire.
gaps.explanation: 'His bravery' — quality noun; 'braveness' exists but is rare; 'bravery' is standard.

gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ (CONFIDENT) in front of the camera.
Her ___ (ANALYSE) of the data took three weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'Analysis' is the noun for a detailed examination; an 'analyst' is a person.
